pairs: And having entered, he walked through Jericho.
And behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus.
And he was the leader of the tax collectors,
And he sought to see Jesus,
But he was unable to do so,
because of the crowd, for he was small in stature.
Et præcurrens ascendit in arborem sycomorum ut videret eum:
And running ahead, he climbed up a sycamore tree, so that he might see him.
For he was to pass near there.
And when he had arrived at the place,
Jesus looked up and saw him,
quia hodie in domo tua oportet me manere.
For today, I should lodge in your house.”
And when they all saw this,
dicentes quod ad hominem peccatorem divertisset.

do pauperibus: et si quid aliquem defraudavi,
And if I have cheated anyone in any matter,
Quia hodie salus domui huic facta est:
“Today, salvation has come to this house;
eo quod et ipse filius sit Abrahæ.
because of this, he too is a son of Abraham.
For the Son of man has come to seek
and to save what had been lost.”
As they were listening to these things, continuing on,
et quia existimarent quod confestim regnum Dei manifestaretur.
and because they guessed that the kingdom of God might be manifested without delay.

“A certain man of nobility traveled to a far away region, to receive for himself a kingdom,
And so they sent a delegation after him,
‘We do not want this one to reign over us.’
Et factum est ut rediret accepto regno:
And it happened that he returned, having received the kingdom.

Sciebas quod ego homo austerus sum,

taking up what I did not lay down,

qui noluerunt me regnare super se,

you will find the colt of a donkey,

you shall say this to him:

And those who were sent went out,
and they found the colt standing,
Then, as they were untying the colt,
dixerunt domini ejus ad illos: Quid solvitis pullum?
its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
“Because the Lord has need of it.”
And they led it to Jesus.
Et jactantes vestimenta sua supra pullum,
And casting their garments on the colt,
they were laying down their garments along the way.
et cum appropinquaret jam ad descensum montis Oliveti,
And when he was now drawing near to the descent of Mount Olivet,
cœperunt omnes turbæ discipulorum gaudentes laudare Deum voce magna super omnibus,
the entire crowd of his disciples began to praise God joyfully,
over all the powerful works which they had seen,

pax in cælo, et gloria in excelsis.
